name: media-vault
description: ⚠ SETUP FIRST: media-vault needs a separate PostgreSQL 16 database — install a "postgres:16-alpine" container first, then set this container's DB Host/Port/Name/User/Password to point at it. A self-hosted, open-source catalog for physical media (games, movies, vinyl, CDs) with automatic cover/rating/description enrichment and a signature spine-shelf view. 📖 Full setup guide (install, get the free artwork keys, add them in the app): https://github.com/halvar20000/media-vault/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

paths.name: Covers Volume
paths.description: Where cached cover images are stored.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the app is reached on.

variables.name: DB Host
variables.description: Postgres container IP or hostname.

variables.name: DB Port
variables.description: Postgres port.

variables.name: DB Name
variables.description: Database name.

variables.name: DB User
variables.description: Database user.

variables.name: DB Password
variables.description: Database password.

variables.name: Session Secret (optional)
variables.description: Leave BLANK — one is auto-generated and saved on first boot. Only set this if you want to supply your own long random string (e.g. from: openssl rand -base64 32).

variables.name: App Origin
variables.description: Public URL of the app (e.g. http://TOWER-IP:8080).

variables.name: Allow Registration
variables.description: Let new users self-register. Keep false on an exposed instance.

variables.name: Marketplace
variables.description: Which second-hand marketplace(s) the 'find deals / bundles' buttons search. Comma-separated — each value adds its own button (e.g. leboncoin,medimops,kleinanzeigen). Values: leboncoin (France), kleinanzeigen (Germany), ebay-de, ebay-com, ebay-uk, ebay-fr, marktplaats (Netherlands), wallapop (Spain), medimops (German used-media shop), easycash (French used-goods shop), or none to hide the buttons.

variables.name: Easy Cash store
variables.description: Optional: pin Easy Cash 'find deal' links to one physical store. Use the store's exact facet value (department + name), e.g. '68 - Mulhouse'. Blank = all stores / full online catalogue.

variables.name: Craigslist city
variables.description: US only: Craigslist is per-city. Set your site subdomain, e.g. newyork, sfbay, losangeles. Required for Craigslist links (no national search). Blank = Craigslist hidden. (Also settable in the app's Settings panel.)

variables.name: HTTPS (production cookies)
variables.description: Set to 'production' ONLY behind HTTPS (reverse proxy); otherwise leave 'development'.

variables.name: Login email
variables.description: The admin account created on first boot — this is the email you log in with. Change it or keep the default.

variables.name: Login password
variables.description: Password for the login above (created on first boot). CHANGE THIS from 'changeme', especially if the instance is reachable outside your LAN.

variables.name: IGDB Client ID
variables.description: Twitch app Client ID (games).

variables.name: IGDB Client Secret
variables.description: Twitch app Client Secret (games).

variables.name: TMDB Access Token
variables.description: TMDB v4 Read Access Token (movies).

variables.name: TMDB Language
variables.description: Movie metadata language, e.g. de-DE.

variables.name: Discogs Key
variables.description: Discogs consumer key (vinyl/CD).

variables.name: Discogs Secret
variables.description: Discogs consumer secret (vinyl/CD).

variables.name: PriceCharting Token
variables.description: PAID PriceCharting API token for game valuation (optional; eBay below is a free alternative). Music valuation uses Discogs; movies have no price source.

variables.name: eBay Client ID (App ID)
variables.description: FREE game valuation via eBay. Register an app at developer.ebay.com (Production keyset) and paste the App ID here. When set, games are valued from eBay used-listing prices (takes priority over PriceCharting).

variables.name: eBay Client Secret (Cert ID)
variables.description: eBay Cert ID (Client Secret) that pairs with the App ID above.

variables.name: eBay Marketplace
variables.description: Which eBay site/currency to price against: EBAY_DE (EUR), EBAY_FR (EUR), EBAY_GB (GBP), EBAY_US (USD), EBAY_IT, EBAY_ES…

variables.name: Steam Web API key
variables.description: Optional: import your owned Steam games via Add → Steam. Get a free key at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Your Steam profile's Game details must be Public. Can also be set in the app's Settings.

variables.name: Valuation Currency
variables.description: Currency for Discogs marketplace prices (EUR, USD, GBP…).
